zh.title: 日航聯營 Jetstar Japan A320 抵達桃園
zh.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測顯示，註冊號 JA16JJ、呼號 JJP14 的 Airbus A320 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（RCTP）。
body: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，註冊號為 JA16JJ 的 Airbus A320 機型於 2026 年 8 月 9 日抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE；RCTP）。
該次飛行呼號為 JJP14，營運者為 Jetstar Japan（營運者 ICAO：JJP）。
本次抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為飛機位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground。
首次有效觀測時間為 2026 年 8 月 9 日 04:02:30Z，確認抵達時間為 2026 年 8 月 9 日 05:12:35Z。
有效觀測筆數為 2 筆，資料來源包括 Airplanes.live 與 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 confirmed_by_primary_only。
統計說明顯示，系統觀測歷史累積中尚無可比較的長期統計。

en.title: Jetstar Japan A320 Arrival at Taoyuan Airport
en.summary: Public ADS-B tracking shows an Airbus A320 registered JA16JJ, callsign JJP14, arriving at Taoyuan International Airport (RCTP) on August 9, 2026.
body: Public ADS-B observation data indicates that an Airbus A320, registration JA16JJ, arrived at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) (RCTP) on August 9, 2026.
The flight was operating under callsign JJP14, with Jetstar Japan (ICAO: JJP) listed as the operator.
The arrival was confirmed based on the aircraft being within the airport geofence with an altitude (alt_baro) of ground level.
The first valid observation time was recorded at 04:02:30 UTC, with the confirmed arrival time at 05:12:35 UTC.
A total of two valid observations were recorded, sourced from Airplanes.live and ADSB.lol, with cross-confirmation status marked as confirmed_by_primary_only.
According to the statistical notes, there is currently no comparable long-term historical data available in the system.
